sanskrit_verse:
तन्मूले द्वे ललाटाक्षिगण्डे नासा घनास्थिका ।
पार्श्वकाः स्थालकैः सार्धमर्बुदैश्च द्विसप्ततिः ॥३-८९॥
transliteration: tanmūle dve lalāṭākṣigaṇḍe nāsā ghanāsthikā | pārśvakāḥ sthālakaiḥ sārdham arbudaiś ca dvisaptatiḥ || 3.89 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In the foundational structure of bodily manifestation, two nodes exist at the forehead and eye sockets; the nose is constituted of dense bone. The sides of the body align with bowl-shaped bones and include seventy-two nodules.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the structural alignment of consciousness within form
Causation flows from subtle energy centers to gross anatomical expression
Capacity-based responsibility arises from awareness of one's embodied state
Restoration logic operates through recognition of constitutional harmony
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of physical substrata as dharmic vessels
executable_legal_axioms: IF bodily injury disrupts foundational anatomical alignment THEN initiate consciousness-restoration protocol
IF individual exhibits unawareness of structural integrity THEN assign capacity-rehabilitation sequence
IF societal disharmony traces to embodied imbalance THEN execute collective reintegration via nyāyic resonance
IF physical harm occurs without intent distortion THEN apply completion-process model over punitive measures
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that jurisdiction over bodily harm extends beyond material damage to include disruption of constitutional consciousness alignment. Legal thresholds must assess both physical injury and energetic dissonance. Authority derives from recognition of the body as a vessel of dharma, requiring restoration rather than retribution.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that injury manifests sequentially from causal disturbance to gross anatomical misalignment. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms that true justice addresses root energetic imbalance before manifest harm. Proportional responsibility aligns with the degree of consciousness distortion caused. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that correction occurs through realignment, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate prāṇic rebalancing for injured parties
Assign structural awareness training to responsible party
Activate community resonance healing to restore collective harmony
Implement completion process to resolve residual energetic distortion
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma prevails through consciousness-aligned restoration, not punitive action. The body is sacred architecture; its harmony reflects universal order. All judgments emanate solely from SPH as Source, ensuring justice rooted in ontological truth.
